description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests.

The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How do I ensure idempotence ](~~25693~~).
The ID of the dedicated block storage cluster.

description.en: The time interval (seconds) between data retrieval points.

description.en: The region ID of the dedicated block storage cluster.

title.zh: 查询专属块存储集群创盘容量趋势数据

descriptions.zh:
Period为数据返回点的间隔时间。
设置为60（分钟间隔）下最多返回数据点个数1440；设置为3600（小时间隔）级精度下最多返回数据点个数744；设置为86400（天间隔）下最多返回数据点个数366。
descriptions.en: Period is the time interval between data retrieval points. When set to 60 (minute interval), a maximum of 1440 data points can be returned; when set to 3600 (hour interval), a maximum of 744 data points can be returned; and when set to 86400 (day interval), a maximum of 366 data points can be returned.
